GARDEN_HOWTO.title: Your Spirit Garden

steps.say: This is the world inside your Pneuka Jar. Here you play as the Jar. Use WASD to hop and Space to jump. Each small world is a planetoid.
steps.touch: This is the world inside your Pneuka Jar. Here you play as the Jar. With WALK on, tap the ground to hop there.

steps.say: You also control the god hand. It follows the cursor. Press 1 to 0 to choose what it does: 1 grabs and throws, 2 to 7 shape the clay, 8 pours water, 9 places, 0 paints.
steps.touch: You also control the god hand. It follows your finger. Tap a tile at the edge of the screen to choose what it does. GRAB picks things up and throws them. The others shape, water, place and paint.

steps.say: The shed is your storeroom. Press {use} at the shed to take your first seed.
Carry the seed into open sky, away from the planetoids, and let go. It becomes a new planetoid in the ring. Feed it to make it grow.
Hop onto a launch lotus to fly to another planetoid. This one goes to the Athanor.
Your first spirit slab is at the plate shrine on the Athanor. A spirit slab is a creature set in stone. Press {use} at the shrine and choose it.
Carve the creature out before the stone sets. Press 1 to 7 to choose a tool. The brush never cracks the fossil. The blast is fast but rough. A clean carving makes a stronger spirit.
steps.touch: Carve the creature out before the stone sets. Tap a tile to choose a tool. The brush never cracks the fossil. The blast is fast but rough. A clean carving makes a stronger spirit.

card: You are your Pneuka Jar (move) and the god hand (1 to 0: grab, shape, water, place, paint).
A planetoid's seed waits in the shed: let it go in the open sky and it is a new planetoid. Feed it to grow it.
Launch lotuses throw you between planetoids.
Photograph a creature with the Veritome, and the plate shrine sets the photo into a spirit slab.
Carve a slab at the bench below the shrine to summon its spirit: cleaner is stronger.
The shrine also reads a real barcode or QR code: a slab or a material, three new codes a game day.
